about: The Workbench icons of the AmuletsArmor drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). art/amuletsarmor.png is the game's own A&A icon (Artwork/Icons/AnAIcon.png, Amulets & Armor, United Software Artists, GPL-3.0), fitted to 64 x 64. AmuletsArmor-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, AmuletsArmor.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for LICENSE.txt.
